name: 13_charset_mislabeled
title: Character set declared wrong for the bytes
description: Both files carry the Latin-1 bytes of TÉST^CARDIO^SYNTH, but B declares ISO_IR 192 (UTF-8), which those bytes are not valid in.
symptom: Garbled or rejected patient names after a gateway relabels the charset; some receivers crash on decode. The tool warns and shows B's name as raw bytes.
